description:
Are you passionate about standardizing data platforms and automating data engineering to drive analytics and reporting? Do you excel in dynamic, fast-paced environments and find joy in converting data into actionable insights? Are you adept at implementing data governance practices and defining data access and quality standards? If you thrive in innovation and can deliver scalable Data Engineering Solutions, then the Worldwide Operations Finance Standardization & Automation (SnA) team has an exciting opportunity for you! We are seeking a customer-centric Senior Data Engineer to establish a reliable and accessible data platform, ensuring Operations Finance customers have complete trust in the data, technology, and tools to make data-driven business decisions.

As a Senior Data Engineer in WW S&A, you will be working in one of the world's largest and most complex data ecosystems. You will design, build, and own scalable data domains that serve as the foundational layer for the business. In this role, you will architect and implement robust, well-governed data domain models that integrate multi-heterogeneous data sources, enabling seamless consumption across a wide spectrum of use cases - including real-time and batch analytics, interactive dashboards and reporting, machine learning and predictive modeling, operational automation, API-driven data services, self-service exploration, and ad-hoc data requests. As a Sr. DE, you will define domain boundaries, establish data contracts, and curate high-quality, discoverable datasets that empower cross-functional teams to derive insights quickly and reliably, while ensuring data is aggregated, retrieved, and served in a fast, secure, and scalable manner across all consumption patterns. You should have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners, Product teams and Tech leaders to gather infrastructure requirements, design data infrastructure, build up data pipelines and data-sets to meet business needs. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and operating a data service platform using Python, Airflow, and SQL to build the various ETL, analytics, and data quality components. You’ll automate deployments using AWS CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline, AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), and AWS Cloud Formation. You will work with AWS services like Redshift, Glue, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and more.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities

- Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources using Python, SQL and AWS big data technologies.
- Explore and learn the latest AWS technologies to provide new capabilities and increase efficiencies of the team.
Designing and implementing complex pipelines and other Data Engineering solutions.
- Work closely with business owners, developers, Business Intelligence Engineer to explore new data sources and deliver the data.
- Create extensible designs and easy to maintain solutions with the long term vision in mind
- Improve tools, processes, scale existing solutions, create new solutions as required based on team and stakeholder needs
- Familiar with AI Delivery Life Cycle (DLC), contributing to the end-to-end process of delivering AI-powered solutions - from ideation and data preparation through model development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

description:
The Outbound Communication Services team is the backbone of Amazon’s customer communication, enabling seamless interactions through Email, SMS, and Push notifications. Our core mission is to ensure the reliable and prompt delivery of selected messages to our customers while also capturing real-time feedback from these communications to refine and optimize our strategies.

Driven by a passion for developing scalable data infrastructures capable of handling billions of transactions and vast amounts of data, we are committed to continuously enhancing both our technical capabilities and the customer experience. 

As a Data Engineer in our team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the way Amazon connects with customers, impacting the interactions of not just the global Amazon community but also those closest to you.

In your role, you'll be at the forefront of reinforcing the technological framework that powers Amazon's direct engagement with its customers. Your expertise will drive the creation of resilient and scalable software solutions capable of managing immense data loads and supporting a high volume of transactions. This role offers a distinctive opportunity to make a profound impact on the customer experience, contribute to the architecture of large-scale distributed systems, and flourish within an innovative team committed to excellence in all operational aspects.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, fault-tolerant data infrastructure for high-volume outbound communication channels.
- Implement robust data flow solutions that integrate seamlessly with real-time messaging systems, ensuring data integrity and efficient processing.
- Collaborate with software engineers to extract, transform, and load data from diverse sources, optimizing for performance and scalability.
- Develop automation tools to enhance data availability, consistency, and compliance, aligning with Amazon's Best At Amazon (BAA) standards.
- Drive continuous improvement in data infrastructure, exploring innovative technologies and methodologies to solve complex data challenges.
- Work closely with stakeholders to understand data requirements, delivering solutions that enable data-driven decision-making and personalized customer experiences.
- Mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and collaboration.
